title: didymocarpus bicornutus

This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include its potential in treating fever, rheumatism, and various other health issues. The bioactive constituents of D. bicornutus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
